en.headline: 251 civil servants dismissed over five years for misconduct or crime
en.dek: Civil Service Bureau figures show 48 dismissals in the latest financial year alone, while a streamlined process has led to five compulsory retirements for persistent underperformance.
body: Hong Kong dismissed 251 civil servants for serious misconduct or criminal convictions across the five financial years from 2021/22 to 2025/26, according to Civil Service Bureau figures submitted to the Legislative Council.

A total of 1,250 staff faced formal disciplinary action and punishment for grave misconduct or after criminal convictions, while another 2,780 received summary discipline for lighter breaches. Of those on the formal track, 251 were dismissed, including 48 cases in 2025/26 alone.

Separately, under a simplified Section 12 process introduced in 2023 to address persistent underperformance, 33 officers received notices in the three years to the end of August 2026 requiring improvement within an observation period or face compulsory retirement. Five were ordered to retire after failing to improve, two left after receiving the notice, six improved enough for the action to be suspended, and 20 cases remain ongoing. The bureau said the streamlined track has sharply increased the number of notices issued and cut average handling time from about 31 months to roughly 11 months.

zh.headline: 五年內251名公務員因不當行為或定罪被免職
zh.dek: 公務員事務局向立法會提交的數字顯示，最近一個財政年度有48宗免職個案，簡化程序下已有五人因表現持續欠佳被勒令退休。
body: 根據公務員事務局向立法會提交的數字，由2021/22至2025/26五個財政年度，共有251名公務員因嚴重不當行為或被裁定干犯刑事罪行而被免職。
期間共有1,250名人員因嚴重不當行為或刑事定罪而須接受正式紀律行動和懲處，另有2,780人因較輕微不當行為接受簡易紀律行動。在正式程序中，251人被免職，當中2025/26財政年度有48宗。
另外，2023年引入簡化的第12條程序處理表現持續欠佳人員後，截至2026年8月底的三年內，共有33名人員獲發通知，須在觀察期內提升表現，否則可能被勒令退休。其中五人因表現未有改善被着令退休，兩人在接獲通知後離職，六人表現改善而暫緩行動，餘下20宗仍在進行。局方表示，簡化程序後發出通知數目顯著增加，平均處理時間由約31個月縮短至約11個月。
